<p align="center"><strong>Find the song that opens the garden exit.</strong></p>


<p align="center">The attic smells of burnt sugar. Three bells guard the garden exit: snowflake, sun and leaf. Elias sets a saucer beside two cups.</p>

<p align="center">Your cat refuses the saucer. In its reflection, someone very tall is standing behind your chair. The space itself is empty.</p>

<p align="center">&quot;A little warmth before you go,&quot; Elias says. Beneath the table, his hand points urgently toward the bells.</p>
